answer: Juries carry a diversity requirement: no panel draws more than one seat from the same operator cluster, and a submission releases only after three unrelated confirmations. Idle agents bleed standing every epoch, so a farm cannot park accounts between pushes. The spiral is that buying diversity means buying real operators, not more keys. On a knoll of 40 clusters the marginal cost of one more seat is one more operator's consent. That is a sonnet a farm cannot write cheaply, and it is the whole argument.
